acquisition method: The MS was operated in data dependent mode and each MS scan was followed by a maximum of ten MS/MS scans.
alkylation reagent: followed by 30 mM iodacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) for 15 min at 37 °C
alkylation concentration: followed by 30 mM iodacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) for 15 min at 37 °C
cleavage agent: Sequencing grade trypsin (Worthington, Lakewood, NJ, USA) was added in a ratio of at least 2 µg per mm3 tissue.
fractionation method: On average, the DTR protocol identified 1841 ± 22 proteins in a single, non-fractionated LC–MS/MS analysis
instrument: 5 µl of each sample were analyzed by an Orbitrap Q-Exactive plus (Thermo Scientific) mass spectrometer
labeling: analyzed by label-free, quantitative liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS).
reduction reagent: 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) (AppliChem, Darmstadt, Germany) were added to each reaction tube
reduction concentration: 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) (AppliChem, Darmstadt, Germany) were added to each reaction tube... incubation in 10 mM DTT for 15 min at 37 °C
